# E8 — restructuring depth: may the model rewrite again what a kept rewrite leaves or exposes?

*Generated by `agent/tools/campaign.py reports` from `results/campaign.json` and the experiment record (`agent/THESIS_EXPERIMENTS.md`). Edit those, then regenerate — not this file.*

**Status:** designed 13 Oct — put to the author; no trial run

## The question

After the agent keeps a rewrite it profiles the program again and may find new regions. At depth 0 — every experiment so far — such a region gets DiscoPoP's pragma at most, never a second rewrite; at depth 1 the model may be asked about it once more. Does a second level parallelize regions the first level's rewrites exposed, and what does it cost in calls, profiles and the speed of the result? (RQ8, H8; C1, C3)

## Result in one paragraph

Not run. Read from the archive instead (`preflight/depth_from_the_archive.md`, no model): at depth 0 the agent already lists what a deeper level would send to the model. On the 18 loops (the corrected table of E3), where DiscoPoP writes the pragma a deeper level would have asked the model in 80 of the 80 trials with an accepted rewrite — about the repetition loop, which the model had already been asked about in all 80, and about the function around it; about any other loop in 4 trials, on 2 loops (`s252`, `s331`). Where the model writes the pragma: in 20 of 84, about those two regions only. Two properties of depth as built, read in the code and not shown by a run: with a deeper level to come the first level no longer sends a rewrite back as not faster (at depth 0 that happens in 38 of 90 trials, 25 of which end FASTER), and a second rewrite can be credited with the first one's gain. Put to the author on 13 Oct with the decision who writes the pragmas in the experiments that remain: no depth trials (recommended), a repaired depth on the few loops with a second task, or the experiment as registered.
